title: Complete two-pivot caller readers and certify fixed-chart retiming costs
body:
## Summary

- Complete both dirty-pivot readers and every original-input reader in the two-pivot caller. For n=2q+2, the all-q histogram is H_(2f)=n²+2, H_(4f)=1: full stock plus 8f.
- Certify the fixed six-bank native-product chart floor at 72f using 36 edge-disjoint odd Eulerian subgraphs, with a matching word. Complete eight-bank quadratic retimings improve 138f to 130f against stock 128f; they remain unfavorable.
- Add only `research/two-pivot-caller-readers/`. Of 277,041 added lines, 272,613 (98.4%) are frozen JSON evidence; Python totals 3,535 lines. Review the proof and verifier before the receipts.

## Scope and limits

The all-q construction covers integers q≥2 and f≥1. The 72f floor applies only to the retained six-bank skeleton and native-product chart compiler. It is not a bound for changed callers, new charts, or all eight-bank words. Finite exact replays and written all-parameter proofs are separate evidence.

The broader favorable-supplier target remains open: literal selected-native lowerings, contracting splits, compatible BIT, owners, precision, storage, fixed-tape costs and complete recursive/outer admission are unresolved. No new κ, selected-frontier change or formal-kernel theorem is claimed.

See the [proof](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/896e2a2e89fd2b54d4defafaef3b91bb4b33b493/research/two-pivot-caller-readers/FIXED-CHART-PROOF.md), [coverage and limits](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/896e2a2e89fd2b54d4defafaef3b91bb4b33b493/research/two-pivot-caller-readers/README.md), and [task, scope change and open next questions](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/896e2a2e89fd2b54d4defafaef3b91bb4b33b493/research/two-pivot-caller-readers/TASK.json).

## Test plan

- [x] Fresh review at `896e2a2e89fd2b54d4defafaef3b91bb4b33b493`: `python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/two-pivot-caller-readers --check-source-history` and `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-pivot-caller-readers --check-only` pass. These establish committed bytes, history, metadata and pins.
- [x] [Existing hosted CI run 39248120264](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39248120264) is completed/success at that exact head, including registered normal/optimized replay. Reproduce with `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-pivot-caller-readers`. This review reused that run; it did not rerun the package suite.
- [x] Separate AI review checked the all-q derivation and independently rebuilt the fixed-chart graph/certificate and matching word maps; no actionable defect was found within that scope.

The earlier author-reported local and Git-free export checks are recorded in the [canonical finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3606#discussioncomment-19039338). AI review is not independent human or formal-kernel acceptance.
